text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross got injured during training,
so I brought her to the infirmary.
choice_data_list: Sorry, I should have been more careful.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What're ya apologizin' for?
This ain't nobody's fault, so wipe that gloomy look off yer face.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: A scratch like this'll heal in no time! Cheer up!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, why am *I*, the injured one,
cheering *you* up?! Ain't it supposed to be the other way around?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha. Looks like some life's come back to ya.
Alright, no time to waste, let's get right back to trainin'!
choice_data_list: Let's call it a day and get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You're making a big deal out of it. An injury like this
happens all the time, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ah, jeez! Don't go getting all gloomy over every little thing!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Fine, whatever. It's annoying when you're all down in the dumps anyway...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Fine. I'll take today off then.
With a disappointed remark, Tamamo Cross headed back to the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Alright! Let's go for a run!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No good. That injury from earlier
might've gotten worse.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If I knew it'd turn out like this,
I should've just stayed quiet...
Afterward, I walked Tamamo Cross back to her dorm and made sure she got plenty of rest.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Alright! Let's go for a run!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Looking good!
I knew it wasn't gonna be a big deal after all!"

The injury seemed to have little effect,
and Tamamo Cross was able to train within reasonable limits.
